title: The Absurdity of Detecting Gravitational Waves
summary: Veritasium explains in detail how LIGO detects gravitational waves, with a laser interferometer measuring displacements smaller than a proton. The video focuses on the extreme precision and the techniques needed rather than the general discovery story.
why: HN recommends it as a good layperson explanation of how LIGO's detection works and why it is so hard.
